lead.headline: Golden and Love still limited; Jacobs is off the report
lead.deck: Rice stays out of the picture. Jacobs over Gordon is a coin flip the projection takes once Friday confirms him.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice did not practise Wednesday (hamstring/knee, Chiefs.com 21 Oct) and stays at 0.0. Matthew Golden (shoulder) and his quarterback Jordan Love (back) were both limited; Love calls it 'a sore back from the game' and says he isn't worried about Sunday (Packers Wire 22 Oct). Xavier Worthy — KC's focal receiver now, team-high 28 routes in Week 6 (ESPN 21 Oct) — is Golden's fallback and plays after Green Bay's inactives. Josh Jacobs practised and is off Green Bay's injury report; Rapoport expects him to play (Packernet 22 Oct). He projects 0.9 above Ollie Gordon II — a coin flip, taken by projection once Friday's report confirms him, before Gordon's 11:00 kickoff.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to fire today — Jacobs waits for Friday
doFirst.deck: Golden has a live fallback in Worthy; Jacobs over Gordon only if Friday clears him by 10:30 Sunday.
doFirst.note: No claims: priority never resets and every riser fills a vacancy. Hold the Jets D/ST and Gay.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to fire this Thursday morning — Jacobs and Golden are decided by Friday's report and Sunday's inactives.
